## Summary

## Validation

If a relevant check was not performed, explain why.

## AI assistance

Select one:

- [ ] No AI assistance was used.
- [ ] AI was used only for advice, research, explanation, or review.
- [ ] AI was used to generate or modify contribution content.

If AI generated or modified content, describe its role, the affected
parts, and how you reviewed and validated the output.

## Contributor confirmation

- [ ] I have reviewed the complete contribution, understand the changes,
      and can explain their purpose, behavior, and relevant design choices.
- [ ] I have verified relevant claims and validation results and corrected
      identified deficiencies.
- [ ] I accept responsibility for the entire contribution, including any
      AI-generated or AI-modified content, and will address review feedback
      and problems in my changes.
- [ ] I have the necessary rights to contribute all included material under
      the project's applicable license terms and have preserved required
      attribution and notices.
- [ ] Any changes applied by AI were explicitly authorized by a human
      and remained within the authorized scope.
- [ ] No AI tool created, amended, rewrote, or signed the commits
      included in this contribution.
